# Merge Society

> Merge Society is a software engineering and technology platform that publishes programming tutorials, AI resources, developer guides, technology news, company analysis, coding best practices, and educational content for developers of all experience levels.

Merge Society helps developers stay informed, improve their programming skills, and understand modern software engineering technologies through practical tutorials, industry news, and in-depth technical articles.

## Main Website

- [Merge Society](https://mergesociety.com) - Homepage and entry point to all content.

## Programming Tutorials

- [Tutorials](https://mergesociety.com/articles) - Step-by-step programming tutorials covering JavaScript, React, Next.js, CSS, HTML, Node.js, Python, AI, and modern web development.

## Technology News

- [Latest Tech News](https://mergesociety.com/news) - Coverage of major announcements, software releases, AI developments, developer tools, and industry trends.

## Tech Companies

- [Technology Companies](https://mergesociety.com/companies) - Profiles, analysis, and updates on software companies, AI companies, startups, and major technology organizations.
